title.target: zhǐ shàng hái méi zǒu wán de lù
title.english: The Roads Still on the Page

pairs.target: rètāng shànglái shí , xià róng guǒrán méi chí . tā jiāng wǎn fàngdào tǎ wéi pángbiān , cháo hòu zhāoshǒu , jiào jì huái bǎ kuàizi yě nálái .
pairs.english: Xiarong was indeed on time when the hot soup arrived. She set her bowl beside Tavi, waved behind her and called for Ji Huai to bring chopsticks too.
pairs.hanzi: 热汤上来时，夏绒果然没迟。她将碗放到塔维旁边，朝后招手，叫纪槐把筷子也拿来。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhè cái zhīdào huōyá bān gōng de míngzì , kāikǒu jiào le yìshēng jì shīfu , duìfāng xiān kàn tā , hūrán xiào le , shuō bié tóng dù chéng xué , zìjǐ méiyǒu túdì , lián jiālǐ nà bǎ dèngzǐ yě xiū bùhǎo .
pairs.english: Only then did Tavi learn the gap-toothed porter's name and call him Master Ji. The man looked at him, then suddenly laughed: don't copy Du Cheng; he had no apprentice and could not even fix the stool at home.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维这才知道豁牙搬工的名字，开口叫了一声纪师傅，对方先看他，忽然笑了，说别同杜澄学，自己没有徒弟，连家里那把凳子也修不好。

pairs.target: sāngè rén jǐ zài yìzhāng xiǎo zhuōbiān chī wán , jì huái méi zài tí gōngqián , wèn de dǎo shì bái jiē chīfàn yǒuméiyǒu zhèbiān fàng dé duō .
pairs.english: The three ate crowded around a small table. Ji Huai did not mention wages again, instead asking whether the White Steps served portions as generous as here.
pairs.hanzi: 三个人挤在一张小桌边吃完，纪槐没再提工钱，问的倒是白阶吃饭有没有这边放得多。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō kàn shuí shèng , xià róng biàn jiào tā jiǎngqīng shì nǎ yígè , xiàhuí yǒu jīhuì qù le , xiānpái nàbiān de duì . huà jiǎng dé xiàng míngrì biàn qù , shuí yě méiyǒu dàngchéng yìzhāng yào rén duìxiàn de yuē .
pairs.english: Tavi said it depended who served. Xiarong told him to specify which person, so next time she had a chance she could queue there first. They spoke as if going tomorrow, but nobody treated it as a promise to be redeemed.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说看谁盛，夏绒便叫他讲清是哪一个，下回有机会去了，先排那边的队。话讲得像明日便去，谁也没有当成一张要人兑现的约。

pairs.target: cìrì zǎoshàng , yuē hǎo de bàn bān zhàojiù zuò . háishì tóng yílèi xiāngdǐ yǔ hédìng de qīngzǎi , wēn xiù zài páng , dù chéng yǔ zhǎng lún de rén kànzhe fēng kuàng .
pairs.english: Next morning the agreed half shift went ahead, still with the same kind of crate base and approved light load. Wenxiu was present; Du Cheng and the wheel operator watched the wind conditions.
pairs.hanzi: 次日早上，约好的半班照旧做。还是同一类箱底与核定的轻载，温岫在旁，杜澄与掌轮的人看着风况。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi ná yàng kuàng jì le liǎngcì jiētóuchù de kuāndù , yòu jiāng xià róng huàn guò zhànwèi hòu de tíngdùn dān jì chūlái . méiyǒu xīntiān huò , yě méiyǒu bǎ zuórì méi shì guò de cháng xiāng hùnjìnlái .
pairs.english: Tavi used the gauge frame to record the joint's width twice and noted separately the pause after Xiarong changed position. No cargo was added, nor were untested long crates mixed in.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维拿样框记了两次接头处的宽度，又将夏绒换过站位后的停顿单记出来。没有新添货，也没有把昨日没试过的长箱混进来。

pairs.target: bàn bān jiéshù , liǎng rén de qián zhào xīn tiáo jiéqīng . dǒng lǐshì méiyǒu dào , jìzhàng de rén dàilái tā de kǒuxìn , shuō wǎnghòu de yònggōng hái zài jǐjiā zhījiān shāngyì , hòutiān qián gěi dù chéng yígè shuōfǎ .
pairs.english: The half shift ended and both workers were paid under the new slip. Director Dong did not come, but the bookkeeper brought her message: future staffing was still being discussed among the firms, with an answer for Du Cheng before the day after tomorrow.
pairs.hanzi: 半班结束，两人的钱照新条结清。董理事没有到，记账的人带来她的口信，说往后的用工还在几家之间商议，后天前给杜澄一个说法。

pairs.target: jì huái tīng wán , xiān wèn kǒuxìn shìbushì kěyǐ zhàoyàng jì zài zhàng biān , duìfāng diǎntóu , tā cái jiāng zìjǐ de mù qiānshōu qǐ .
pairs.english: After hearing it, Ji Huai first asked whether the message could be recorded exactly beside the accounts. Only after the bookkeeper nodded did he put away his tally.
pairs.hanzi: 纪槐听完，先问口信是不是可以照样记在账边，对方点头，他才将自己的木签收起。

pairs.target: wǔhòu , yìbāo gài zhe xuégōng jiù kù yìn de zhuǎnjì zhǐ dào le .
pairs.english: That afternoon, a forwarded packet bearing the academy archive's seal arrived.
pairs.hanzi: 午后，一包盖着学宫旧库印的转寄纸到了。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng zhèngzài gōngpéng chāi liángjù xiāng , tǎ wéi rènchū shōujiàn chù , chàdiǎn yǐwéi shì zìjǐ gěi mǐlā xiě de xìn tuìhuílái , ná jìn cái kànjiàn pángbiān lìng liè zhe xiānqián cháxún de tú míng .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng was opening a gauge case in the workshop. Recognizing the address, Tavi nearly thought his letter to Mira had been returned, then brought it closer and saw the title of his earlier drawing inquiry listed separately beside it.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡正在工棚拆量具箱，塔维认出收件处，差点以为是自己给米拉写的信退回来，拿近才看见旁边另列着先前查询的图名。

pairs.target: jiù kù de rén zhǎodào le lìng yízuò jiàzi de xiūlǐ bó , yǒu yìlán qīngqīngchǔchǔ xiě zhe lián xiū hào , pángbiān lìng yǒu gòujiàn hào , liǎngzhě búshì yì huíshì .
pairs.english: The archive staff had found another structure's repair book, with one column clearly labeled joint-repair number and a separate component-number column beside it. They were not the same thing.
pairs.hanzi: 旧库的人找到了另一座架子的修理簿，有一栏清清楚楚写着联修号，旁边另有构件号，两者不是一回事。

pairs.target: kòu shīfu jìde de nàzhǒng páifǎ quèshí yòng guò , yígè lián xiū hào xiàmiàn kěyǐ liè jǐchù jiē jiàn , yě néng liè bùtóng de gōng bān , bùnéng kànjiàn jǐgè xiānglín shùzì , jiù dāng tāmen shì xiānglín de jǐkuài tiě .
pairs.english: The arrangement Master Kou remembered had indeed been used: one joint-repair number could include several fittings and different work crews. Adjacent numbers could not simply be taken for adjacent iron pieces.
pairs.hanzi: 寇师傅记得的那种排法确实用过，一个联修号下面可以列几处接件，也能列不同的工班，不能看见几个相邻数字，就当它们是相邻的几块铁。

pairs.target: suí xìn lái de búshì zhé tóng zhěng tú , zhǐshì yìzhāng chá dào chūchù de jiù lánshì chāo yàng , yuán bó míng hé yèshù dōu xiě zài biānshàng .
pairs.english: The enclosure was not a complete Zhetong plan, only a sourced copy of an old column layout, with the original book title and page number written beside it.
pairs.hanzi: 随信来的不是折桐整图，只是一张查到出处的旧栏式抄样，原簿名和页数都写在边上。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng jiāng tā tānkāi , tǎ wéi cái kànjiàn xiàmiàn háiyǒu yìtiáo , láizì lìng yícè qiānshōu mùlù , liè zhe zhé tóng jiù xiūlǐ bó suǒ tí de xī wā zhuǎn xiàn .
pairs.english: When Ruan Heng spread it out, Tavi saw another entry below, from a separate receiving catalog listing the West Hollow Transfer Route mentioned in Zhetong's old repair book.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡将它摊开，塔维才看见下面还有一条，来自另一册签收目录，列着折桐旧修理簿所提的西洼转线。

pairs.target: nà yìháng hòumiàn xiě de búshì shānlù , érshì shuǐyùn jiē tái .
pairs.english: After that entry came not “mountain road” but “water-transport receiving platform.”
pairs.hanzi: 那一行后面写的不是山路，而是水运接台。

pairs.target: cè zhōng zhī jì jiēshōu guò yìpī tuō guǐ yǔ kòujiàn , méiyǒu fù lùxiàn , yě méiyǒu shuō táizi rújīn hái zài , gèng bùnéng cóng zhèlǐ suàn chū dāngnián yòng shénme bànfǎ jiè xìng .
pairs.english: The catalog only recorded receiving a batch of support rails and catches, with no route attached and no statement that the platform still existed. Still less could this reveal how borrowing had been done then.
pairs.hanzi: 册中只记接收过一批托轨与扣件，没有附路线，也没有说台子如今还在，更不能从这里算出当年用什么办法借性。

pairs.target: kě shuǐyùn liǎnggè zì bìng bú dàn , chāo yàng de rén hái zài pángbiān zhùmíng yuán zì qīngchǔ .
pairs.english: But the two characters for water transport were not faint; the copyist had even noted beside them that the original was clear.
pairs.hanzi: 可水运两个字并不淡，抄样的人还在旁边注明原字清楚。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiāng zìjǐ cóng shā dēng dàihuí de tú tān zài pángbiān . tú shàng de xìxiàn réngrán zǒu dào pò jiǎo biàn méi le .
pairs.english: Tavi spread his Sandlamp drawing beside it. The fine line on the plan still ended at the torn corner.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维将自己从砂灯带回的图摊在旁边。图上的细线仍然走到破角便没了。

pairs.target: tā yuánxiān zǒng yánzhe shānjǐ qù xiǎng nàtiáo jiù xiàn zěnyàng wǎng wài jiē , rújīn què hūrán xiǎngqǐ tái jǐng mùliào pù de dēng , hé nà jù xià le shān yě yào shuì wūlǐ dehuà .
pairs.english: He had always imagined the old line continuing outward along ridges; now he suddenly remembered the lamp in Moss Well's timber shop and the remark about sleeping in rooms even down the mountains.
pairs.hanzi: 他原先总沿着山脊去想那条旧线怎样往外接，如今却忽然想起苔井木料铺的灯，和那句下了山也要睡屋里的话。

pairs.target: wēn xiù cóng ménwài jìnlái , tīngjiàn ruǎn héng jiāng chūchù jiǎngwán , xiān wèn jiù mùlù lǐ de jiē tái shìbushì yǔ xiànjīn de hé wèi xiāngtóng .
pairs.english: Wenxiu came in, heard Ruan Heng explain the sources, then first asked whether the old catalog's platform matched the present river position.
pairs.hanzi: 温岫从门外进来，听见阮衡将出处讲完，先问旧目录里的接台是不是与现今的河位相同。

pairs.target: shuí dōu dá bú shàng , tā biàn bǎshǒu shōuhuí , méi ná zìjǐ xiū guò de suǒ tái tì jiù shuǐ tái bǔ shàng sìgēn zhùzi . tǎ wéi què hěn nán zài bǎ nàge duàn jiǎo dàngchéng yìtiáo lù jiùcǐ dào le tóu .
pairs.english: No one could answer. She withdrew her hand instead of supplying four posts from a cable platform she had repaired to fill in the old water platform. But Tavi could hardly regard the torn corner as the end of a road anymore.
pairs.hanzi: 谁都答不上，她便把手收回，没拿自己修过的索台替旧水台补上四根柱子。塔维却很难再把那个断角当成一条路就此到了头。

pairs.target: tā lìng qǔ zhǐ , jiāng yǐzhī yǔ bùzhī fēnkāi chāo hǎo : lánshì láizì biéjià , lián xiū hào jiěshì hái xū níng qí duì yuán bó ; shuǐyùn jiē tái shì jiù mùlù yuán zì , qùxiàng yǔ xiàncún qíngkuàng dōu wèi hé .
pairs.english: He took another sheet and copied knowns and unknowns separately: the column layout came from another structure, and Ningqi still needed to compare the joint-repair-number interpretation with the original book. “Water-transport receiving platform” was the old catalog's actual wording; its location and present condition remained unverified.
pairs.hanzi: 他另取纸，将已知与不知分开抄好：栏式来自别架，联修号解释还须宁岐对原簿；水运接台是旧目录原字，去向与现存情况都未核。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng zài páng kànguò , bǎ yào jìhuí yù hé de dìzhǐ xiěgěi tā , shōujiàn réng zài zhé tóng , bù suí tāmen huàn dìfāng .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng checked beside him and wrote down Yuhe's address for the reply; she still received mail in Zhetong, without moving when they did.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡在旁看过，把要寄回郁禾的地址写给他，收件仍在折桐，不随他们换地方。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi méiyǒu tì nà jǐkuài jiù tiě chóngxīn biānhào , yě méi huà yìtiáo zìjǐ méi zǒuguò de shuǐlù .
pairs.english: Tavi did not renumber the old iron pieces or draw a water route he had never traveled.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维没有替那几块旧铁重新编号，也没画一条自己没走过的水路。

pairs.target: tā bǎ liǎngzhāng dài chūchù de chāo yàng hé duǎnxìn yìtóng fēng hǎo , fù le yóufèi jiāojìn diànlǐ de dàizǐ , gàosù yù hé , nàtiáo bèi zìjǐ lòudiào de xìxiàn , xiān bié zhào tā de cāixiǎng bǔ huíqù .
pairs.english: He sealed the two sourced copies with a short note, paid postage and put it into the shop's mailbag, telling Yuhe not to restore the fine line he had missed according to his guesses yet.
pairs.hanzi: 他把两张带出处的抄样和短信一同封好，付了邮费交进店里的袋子，告诉郁禾，那条被自己漏掉的细线，先别照他的猜想补回去。

pairs.target: bàngwǎn , wēn xiù jiāng míngrì yào yòng de gōngjù liúzài zhuōbiān , shuō xià yíbù dé qù duìàn kàn xiè huílái de kōngxiāng , bùnéng zhī liáng chūhuò zhè yìtóu .
pairs.english: At dusk Wenxiu left tomorrow's tools beside the table, saying next they needed to inspect empty crates returned on the opposite bank, rather than only measuring this outgoing end.
pairs.hanzi: 傍晚，温岫将明日要用的工具留在桌边，说下一步得去对岸看卸回来的空箱，不能只量出货这一头。

pairs.target: dù chéng yǐ gěi tāmen yuē le tōngxíng de gōnglù chē , rào gǔ guòqù , tiānliàng hòu zǒu , bú zuò diào huò de xiāng .
pairs.english: Du Cheng had booked them a road cart on the open route around the valley, leaving after dawn rather than riding in a hoisted cargo carriage.
pairs.hanzi: 杜澄已给他们约了通行的公路车，绕谷过去，天亮后走，不坐吊货的厢。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi tīng wán , xiān wèn huílái yào jǐshí , cái jiāng zìjǐ de shuǐhú gē dào bēibāo páng .
pairs.english: After hearing it, Tavi first asked when they would return, then set his flask beside his pack.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维听完，先问回来要几时，才将自己的水壶搁到背包旁。

pairs.target: chuāngwài , tiānsè yìdiǎndiǎn yādī , huòchǎng de gāojià zài yuǎnchù zhī shèng hēixiàn .
pairs.english: Outside the window, the sky darkened little by little; the freight-yard towers were only black lines in the distance.
pairs.hanzi: 窗外，天色一点点压低，货场的高架在远处只剩黑线。

pairs.target: xià róng cóng jiēkǒu jīngguò , táitóu wèn tā shìbushì yòu zài děng yímiàn qí . tā shuō méiyǒu , zìjǐ zài kàn lù , tā biàn jiào tā xiàlái , kàn lù yě dé xiān chīfàn , jīnwǎn de tāng yòu kuài màiwán le .
pairs.english: Passing the street corner, Xiarong looked up and asked if he was waiting for another flag. He said no, he was looking at the road. She called him down: looking at roads needed dinner first too; tonight's soup was nearly sold out again.
pairs.hanzi: 夏绒从街口经过，抬头问他是不是又在等一面旗。他说没有，自己在看路，她便叫他下来，看路也得先吃饭，今晚的汤又快卖完了。

pairs.target: tā xiào zhe shōu chuāng , méi bǎ xīn shōudào de zhǐdài dào fànzhuō shàng . nà yìháng shuǐyùn jiē tái réng zài lóushàng , míngrì yě búhuì zǒudiào .
pairs.english: Smiling, he shut the window without taking the newly arrived papers to dinner. The line about the water-transport receiving platform remained upstairs; it would not walk away tomorrow either.
pairs.hanzi: 他笑着收窗，没把新收到的纸带到饭桌上。那一行水运接台仍在楼上，明日也不会走掉。

pairs.target: lóuxià yǒurén tì tā liú le bàntiáo chángdèng , tā duān zhe wǎn guòqù , xiān wèn jì huái , jīn zǎo nà yíxià huànshǒu shìbushì bǐ zuórì shùn le .
pairs.english: Downstairs someone had saved him half a bench. He went over with his bowl and first asked Ji Huai whether this morning's handover had gone more smoothly than yesterday's.
pairs.hanzi: 楼下有人替他留了半条长凳，他端着碗过去，先问纪槐，今早那一下换手是不是比昨日顺了。
